rule: Original research about larval Drosophila melanogaster connectivity or connectome datasets.
notes: Mixed-stage studies are eligible only if larval findings can be identified separately.

rule: Original research on imaging or computational methods that enabled larval Drosophila connectome acquisition and reconstruction.
notes: Examples include electron-microscopy acquisition; image alignment; neuron or synapse segmentation; tracing; reconstruction; proofreading; validation; and connectome data infrastructure.

rule: Not Drosophila melanogaster or not the larval stage.
notes: Do not exclude mixed-stage records if larval data may be separable.

rule: No neural connectivity or connectome contribution relevant to the research question.
notes: Behavioral or physiological findings alone are insufficient unless directly linked to larval circuit/connectivity data.

column6: or other non-primary publication from the primary-study synthesis.
column7: Keep potentially useful reviews separately for background and reference-list searching; do not count them as primary studies.

rule: Abstract missing or title/abstract does not establish species
column7: Do not exclude solely for a missing abstract; retrieve full text or check references.

rule: Full text confirms a prespecified exclusion criterion.
notes: Record one primary exclusion reason per report for the PRISMA flow.

rule: Full text unavailable or eligibility cannot be resolved from accessible evidence.
notes: Record as unavailable/unresolved; do not silently count as excluded for irrelevance.
